formal_statement: PEqualNP.Library.NPHard PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.MCSP → ∃ L : Language Bool, (∃ k : ℕ, L ∈ PEqualNP.Library.DTIME (fun n : ℕ => 2 ^ (n ^ k) + k)) ∧ ¬ (L ∈ PEqualNP.Library.NP ∧ L ∈ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.PPoly)
plain_statement: If MCSP is NP-hard under polynomial-time many-one reductions then some language decided in time 2^(n^k) + k is not in NP intersect P/poly (so EXP differs from ZPP). Murray and Williams, On the (non) NP-hardness of computing circuit complexity, Theory of Computing 13, 2017.
title: Murray and Williams: NP-hardness of MCSP separates EXP from NP intersect P/poly
